body: This is a combination result of https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/23811#discussion_r198020909 and https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11885, ID selector can never be correctly parsed in Angular compiler, but root element only make use of unparsed (raw) selector. @mhevery please do consider this as regression.
The issue doesn't repro in Jit mode (https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-xth7wc) but does repro locally with CLI.

> The issue doesn't repro in Jit mode (https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-xth7wc) but does repro locally with CLI.

@IgorMinar This is an Ivy issue, StackBlitz doesn't support Ivy yet even when using v9. The issue happens in both AOT and JIT (of Ivy).

rename.from: `selector: '#app'` in `app.component.ts` is not working any more after upgrading to 9.0.0
rename.to: bootstrapping apps with `selector: '#app'` in `app.component.ts` is not working any more after upgrading to 9.0.0

body: @trotyl dang, you are right. I thought I hacked stackblitz enough to get to to run ivy in JIT mode, but that was not the case.

issue.title: fix(ivy): support for #id bootstrap selectors
